name: @spencerwill/infra-github
description: Pulumi program for this repo's GitHub settings and CI secrets

scripts.adopt: GITHUB_TOKEN=$(gh auth token) pulumi import github:index/repository:Repository repository "$(pulumi config get repository)" --stack main --protect --generate-code=false --yes
scripts.preview: GITHUB_TOKEN=$(gh auth token) pulumi preview --stack main --diff
scripts.apply: GITHUB_TOKEN=$(gh auth token) pulumi up --stack main --diff
